analysis.summary: JG Chemicals Limited reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27 with record revenue, EBITDA, and PAT, driven by robust demand across end-user applications and disciplined execution. The company is progressing with its brownfield expansion in Naidupeta and the Dahej greenfield facility in Gujarat, both targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27. Management highlighted that increased operating leverage, cost optimization initiatives, and a higher share of specialized, value-added products are expected to support structural margin expansion going forward. Furthermore, the company continues to advance its recycled rubber project (JG TUR) and is expanding its global distribution reach through a proposed subsidiary in Dubai. J.G.Chemicals Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational results, achieving its best-ever quarterly performance with record revenue of INR 3,157 million, EBITDA of INR 363 million, and PAT of INR 261 million.

guidance.claim: Management expects the Dahej facility to reach a minimum 50% to 60% capacity utilization in its first full financial year of operations.
guidance.quote: I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

guidance.claim: The company targets an EBITDA margin of approximately 14% supported by higher-value products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej plant is expected to generate EBITDA margins in the 11% to 12% range.
guidance.quote: and the EBITDA margins that we expect to generate from that project would be in the 11% to 12% range.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej plant is estimated to have a revenue potential of INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
guidance.quote: and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, continuing into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: Q1 FY27 volume growth across major vehicle categories was reported by ATMA as passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture continue to see encouraging traction.
demand_outlook.quote: outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced strong demand and volume growth across all end-user applications during the first quarter of FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA reported significant year-on-year volume growth across major vehicle categories in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As Per ATMA, Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories — PV +26.6% YoY, 2W +16.58% YoY, CV +16.48% YoY, 3W +11.32% YoY.

demand_outlook.claim: Indian tyre majors have announced an estimated capex of about INR 25,000 crore.
demand_outlook.quote: As per recent ATMA reports, an estimated Capex of about INR 25,000 crore has been announced by tyre majors.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry was robust in the fourth quarter and continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand momentum across tire industry was extremely robust right through the fourth quarter and the same momentum has continued in the current quarter as well as we speak.

demand_outlook.claim: Leading tire majors reported double-digit revenue growth for Q4 FY26, with several reporting their best ever quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Leading tire majors have reported double-digit revenue growth for Q4 FY26, with several of them reporting their best ever quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand across almost all categories of vehicles grew and hit a fresh all-time high in the last quarter as per SIAM.
demand_outlook.quote: As per SIAM, demand across almost all categories of vehicle has grown and hit a fresh all-time high in the last quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Current utilization rates for zinc oxide are in the late 70s.
demand_outlook.quote: Our current utilization rates are in the late 70s, and we can easily take this up to the 86% to 87% range as required.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility in Gujarat involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej plant will have a capacity in the range of 15,000 tons to 17,000 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: in the first phase, it would be in the range of 15,000 tons to 17,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream.
capex_expansion.quote: once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is progressing well in parallel, with commissioning expected in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The debottlenecking at Naidupeta is adding a total capacity of about 5,000 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: So, the total capacity being added is about 5,000 tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE as a wholly-owned step-down subsidiary.
capex_expansion.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited, a material subsidiary of JG Chemicals, and consequently a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of JG Chemicals Limited.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27 in parallel with Dahej.
capex_expansion.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Civil construction at the Dahej site is in advanced stages, and equipment, plant and machinery installation commenced during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Civil construction at the Dahej site is now in advanced stages, and equipment, plant and machinery installation has also commenced during the quarter as we speak.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has undertaken brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support future demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside Dahej, we have also undertaken certain brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support the future demand.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Incremental costs including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs were transparently passed on to all customers from April 1, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: In line with our long-standing pricing philosophy, all of these incremental costs, including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs, have been transparently passed on to all our customers with effect from 1st April 2026 itself.

margins_costs.claim: Current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see our current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range, and as we've mentioned before, higher value-added products would help increase the blended margins to the 13% to 14% range.

orders_capacity.claim: Current utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: The company supplies to over 200 domestic customers and over 50 international customers.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, our customer franchise extends to more than 200 domestic customers and over 50 international customers.

orders_capacity.claim: Manufacturing is anchored at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities, which together command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: The combined installed capacity of the West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029.
orders_capacity.quote: With the Gujarat project being commissioned during the current financial year, and once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum, a scale which is perhaps matched today globally by only a few players.

capital_allocation.claim: The company targets a payback period of 3 to 4 years for the Dahej project and other contemplated capex plans.
capital_allocation.quote: Usually in our company, we always look at a payback period of 3 to 4 years, and I think in our past, in the past, we have always been able to achieve that. So, going forward, our target for the Dahej plant as well as other capex plans that are currently being contemplated is in the range of 3 to 4 years, mostly.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts severely impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the company's primary raw material, during the last quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted global supply chain disruptions during the recent months.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months.

risks_headwinds.claim: During March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and huge delays in shipments from Europe.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the month of March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and also there were huge delays in shipments from Europe.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the Gujarat greenfield project in Dahej is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commercially start the recycled rubber project in the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And we hope that in the next 12 months, we should be able to commercially start this project

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to increase the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission the Naidupeta brownfield expansion also in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to continue the strong performance and momentum going forward.
management_commitments.quote: The current quarter is also witnessing strong performance and we expect to continue the strong momentum going forward

management_commitments.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029.
management_commitments.quote: With the Gujarat project being commissioned during the current financial year, and once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum, a scale which is perhaps matched today globally by only a few players.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to completely debottleneck the Naidupeta facility by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: So, this is a gradual process which is going on, and we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
